technical-summary: bigcherry clean --builds [--apply]: build cache GC with a finite policy, protection of builds referenced by processes, run manifests, build-plan locks and installed release receipts, fail-closed on any uninspectable input, and deletion by atomic rename into a private quarantine followed by fd-relative removal that refuses mounts, symlinks and identity changes. apply never touches quarantine leftovers. Merged as #1017; the read-only run on the real work root protects all 145 builds (runner lease or unclassified entries block cleanup, 57 builds have untrusted metadata).
user-summary-candidate: A guarded cleanup for old build caches is available; it deletes nothing it cannot prove unused.
